notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
